wifitrx 教程:WiFi 7 收发器建模与校准wifitrx tutorial: WiFi 7 transceiver modeling & calibration

从射频链路建模原理到 14 步校准的推导、实现与实测验证;本页所有结果图与数字均由构建脚本现场运行模型生成。

From RF chain modeling principles to the derivation, implementation and measured validation of all 14 calibration steps; every figure and number on this page was produced by the build script running the model.

1 收发器架构与建模方法1 Transceiver architecture and modeling approach

1.1 直接变频 IQ 收发器1.1 The direct-conversion IQ transceiver

本教程围绕一颗 CMOS WiFi 7 收发器展开:TX 与 RX 均为直接变频(zero-IF)IQ 结构,信道带宽最高 320 MHz,TX 采用模拟 PA(Psat = 28 dBm,PAE@Psat = 35%),频率综合由 fractional-N PLL 完成。下图是本模型覆盖的信号链:上排为发射链,下排为接收链,中间是共用的 LO/PLL,右侧耦合器引出两条片上观测路径——环回衰减路与包络检波路,它们是所有校准算法的眼睛。

This tutorial is built around a CMOS WiFi 7 transceiver: direct-conversion (zero-IF) IQ on both TX and RX, channel bandwidth up to 320 MHz, an analog PA (Psat = 28 dBm, PAE at Psat = 35%), and a fractional-N PLL for frequency synthesis. The figure shows the signal chain the model covers: TX on top, RX below, the shared LO/PLL in between, and — off the output coupler — the two on-chip observation paths (loopback attenuator and envelope detector) that every calibration algorithm sees the chip through.

为什么直接变频需要大量校准?因为它把对器件匹配的要求换成了对校准的要求:I/Q 两条模拟通路的任何失配都直接变成镜像;LO 与 RF 端口的任何耦合都直接落在信道中央;基带滤波器的工艺偏差直接畸变信号频谱。窄带系统里这些是二阶效应,到了 320 MHz / 4096-QAM(EVM 要求 −38 dB,即误差矢量幅度 1.26%),它们每一项都足以单独超掉整个误差预算。

Why does direct conversion need so much calibration? Because it trades component-matching requirements for calibration requirements: any mismatch between the I and Q analog rails becomes image leakage; any coupling between the LO and RF ports lands dead-center in the channel; any process error in the baseband filters distorts the signal spectrum directly. In narrowband systems these are second-order effects — at 320 MHz / 4096-QAM (TX EVM spec −38 dB, an error vector of 1.26%) each one alone can blow the entire error budget.

1.2 复基带等效建模1.2 Complex-baseband equivalent modeling

模型不在射频载波上仿真。载频 6 GHz 下直接仿 RF 需要 >12 GHz 采样率,而所有我们关心的物理量(失配、泄漏、非线性、相噪)在复基带等效下都有精确表示:实信号 中的复包络 就是仿真变量,采样率只需覆盖信道带宽的少数倍( ,DPD 场景 )。

The model does not simulate the RF carrier. At a 6 GHz carrier a true RF simulation needs >12 GHz sampling, yet every quantity we care about (mismatch, leakage, nonlinearity, phase noise) has an exact representation in the complex-baseband equivalent: for the real signal the complex envelope is the simulation variable, and the sample rate only needs a small multiple of the channel bandwidth ( , with for DPD scenarios).

镜像、LO 泄漏这些'射频现象'在复基带下的形态:实系数处理对 与共轭 作用相同,任何 I/Q 失配都表现为输出中混入 的分量(频谱上翻转到 ,即镜像);LO 泄漏则是叠加在基带上的复常数(DC)。这就是第 4 章所有 IQ/泄漏校准在 FFT bin 上做文章的原因。

What 'RF phenomena' look like at complex baseband: real-coefficient processing acts identically on and its conjugate , so any I/Q mismatch shows up as an component in the output (spectrally mirrored to — the image), and LO leakage is a complex constant (DC) added at baseband. This is why every IQ/leakage calibration in chapter 4 works on FFT bins.

1.3 为什么必须校准:损伤逐项点名1.3 Why calibrate: naming each impairment's cost

下面的实验每次只打开一种损伤,其余全部关闭,让同一帧 1024-QAM OFDM 过 TX→环回→RX,测每种损伤单独的 EVM/ACLR 代价(本页所有数字都由构建脚本现场运行得到)。干净链路 EVM 为 -309.0 dB;仅注入典型 TX IQ 失衡就恶化到 -32.5 dB,仅 −28 dBm 的 LO 泄漏就是 -176.1 dB——对照 4096-QAM 需要的 −38 dB,校准不是锦上添花,而是各项损伤从'不可用'到'达标'的必经之路。

The experiment below turns on one impairment at a time (everything else off) and passes the same 1024-QAM OFDM frame through TX → loopback → RX, measuring each impairment's isolated EVM/ACLR cost (every number on this page was produced by the build script running the model). The clean chain reads -309.0 dB EVM; typical TX IQ imbalance alone degrades it to -32.5 dB, and a −28 dBm LO leak alone to -176.1 dB — against the −38 dB that 4096-QAM demands, calibration is not polish, it is the only route from 'unusable' to 'in spec'.

EVM 预算的合成方式是各独立误差项的功率和(RSS):

Independent error contributions combine as a root-sum-square (RSS) of error powers:

−38 dB 的总预算折算成线性误差功率后,留给每一项的空间都很小:这就是 §7 设计洞察里'低相噪综合器不可妥协'等结论的来源。

Converted to linear error power, a −38 dB total budget leaves little room for any single term — the origin of the design insights in §7, such as the non-negotiable low-phase-noise synthesizer.

2 单位约定2 Units convention

2.1 sqrt(mW) 基带与数字满量程边界2.1 sqrt(mW) baseband and the digital full-scale boundary

模拟域信号统一用 为单位的复包络表示:这样 直接就是瞬时功率 [mW],平均功率 ,增益就是乘系数 ,全链路不需要任何阻抗换算。

Analog-domain signals are complex envelopes in units of : is then instantaneous power in mW, average power is , gain is a plain multiplication by , and no impedance bookkeeping is needed anywhere in the chain.

数字域(DAC 输入、ADC 输出、全部校正器)用满量程归一: 。两个域在数据转换器处衔接,换算系数由转换器的满量程功率参数决定:

The digital domain (DAC input, ADC output, every corrector) is full-scale normalized: . The two domains meet at the data converters; the scale factor comes from the converter's full-scale power parameter:

推荐的数字驱动幅度是 rms 0.10–0.15:给 OFDM 的 PAPR 和 DAC 余量留出空间,同时把 PA 推到有代表性的回退点。

The recommended digital drive is 0.10–0.15 rms: room for OFDM PAPR and DAC headroom while driving the PA at a representative backoff.

y_pa = tx(x)          # sqrt(mW) at the PA output
p_dbm = power_dbm(y_pa)
cap = run_loopback(tx, rx, x, path)  # digital FS again

2.2 相噪单位约定2.2 Phase-noise conventions

相噪谱统一内部用双边带 [rad²/Hz];对外报告用单边带 [dBc/Hz],二者换算:

Phase noise is carried internally as the double-sideband in rad²/Hz and reported as the single-sideband in dBc/Hz:

积分相噪(IPN)与 rms 相位/抖动:

Integrated phase noise (IPN) and rms phase/jitter:

模型里任何 NoiseSource 都带 unit 字段,LOModel 在合成前检查它必须是 rad²/Hz——一个曾经没人读的标签,现在是被强制执行的契约(死旋钮测试的直接产物,见开发说明)。

Every NoiseSource carries a unit field, and LOModel refuses to synthesize anything that is not rad²/Hz — a label nothing used to read, now an enforced contract (a direct product of the dead-knob test; see the developer guide).

3 损伤模型3 Impairment models

3.1 频变 IQ 失衡3.1 Frequency-dependent IQ imbalance

物理来源:I/Q 两条模拟轨(DAC→LPF→VGA 各自一份)不可能完全一致——直流增益差、相位正交误差之外,宽带下两轨的频响也有差异(纹波、群时延失配)。模型采用双实轨结构:两条实 FIR 各自滤波 I、Q,再经带增益/相位误差的正交合成:

Physics: the I and Q analog rails (each its own DAC→LPF→VGA) can never match exactly — beyond DC gain and quadrature phase error, at wide bandwidth the two rails' frequency responses differ too (ripple, group-delay mismatch). The model uses a dual-real-rail structure: real FIRs filter I and Q separately, then the quadrature combiner adds gain and phase error:

以 、 代入,任何这样的失衡都化为 widely-linear 形式——输出同时含 与共轭 两条通路:

Substituting , , any such imbalance reduces to the widely-linear form — the output carries both and its conjugate :

处的单音经 在 处生成镜像,镜像抑制比因此是逐频点的解析真值:

A tone at produces its image at through ; the image rejection ratio is therefore an analytic, per-frequency ground truth:

注意镜像抑制的频率约定: 音的镜像强度由 决定而不是 ——这个符号在开发早期错过一次,由注入真值对拍测试当场抓获,此后所有 IRR 相关代码都以上式为准。

Mind the frequency convention: the image of a tone is set by , not — this sign was got wrong once early in development and caught immediately by the injected-truth tests; every IRR formula since follows the definition above.

3.2 LO 泄漏与相位噪声3.2 LO leakage and phase noise

LO 泄漏:LO 向调制器 RF 端口的馈通,复基带下是叠加的复常数,功率由 lo_leak_dbm 指定(绝对 dBm,默认随机 −32…−22),相位任意。它落在信道正中央,既是频谱杂散又直接吃 EVM。

LO leakage: LO feedthrough to the modulator RF port — at complex baseband an added complex constant whose power is lo_leak_dbm (absolute dBm, randomized −32…−22 by default) at arbitrary phase. It lands dead-center in the channel: a spur and an EVM cost at once.

相位噪声:LO 的相位抖动 乘性作用于信号 。谱由分段折线 描述(环内平台、环路峰化、VCO 滚降),时域合成用 FFT 域整形高斯噪声。默认剖面是 4096-QAM 真正需要的低相噪综合器级别:

Phase noise: LO phase jitter acts multiplicatively, . The spectrum is a piecewise profile (in-band plateau, loop peaking, VCO roll-off), synthesized by FFT-domain shaping of Gaussian noise. The default profile is the low-phase-noise synthesizer class 4096-QAM genuinely requires:

frac-N 杂散:小数分频的调制器残差是周期的,DTC 量化与 INL 把它变成确定性单音,归一频率 ,近整数信道最差(拍频落进环路带宽内)。杂散规划器据此扫信道网格标记'脏信道'。

Fractional-N spurs: the fractional divider's modulator residual is periodic; DTC quantization and INL turn it into deterministic tones at normalized frequencies — worst on near-integer channels where the beat falls inside the loop bandwidth. The spur planner sweeps the channel grid and flags the dirty ones.

3.3 基带 LPF 与温漂3.3 Baseband LPF and temperature drift

信道选择 LPF 的绝对 RC 乘积随工艺漂移 ±20%,片上用电容阵列调谐码补偿。模型:

The channel-select LPF's absolute RC product drifts ±20% with process; on-chip a capacitor-bank code trims it back. The model:

其中 是工艺误差、 是每 LSB 的相对步进(默认 2%)、 是温度系数。滤波器本体是 5 阶 Butterworth(可选 Chebyshev),因果 IIR 实现——它的群时延和启动瞬态都是真实的,第 4 章的捕获对齐要为此买单。

with process error , per-LSB fractional step (2% default) and tempco . The filter itself is a causal 5th-order Butterworth (optionally Chebyshev) IIR — its group delay and startup transient are real, and chapter 4's capture alignment pays for them.

corner 比例全带宽统一:TX 1.3×BW/2 为 DPD 频谱留带宽(洞察②),RX 1.12× 做信道选择。20 MHz 的单 LPF ISI 地板实测 −55(1.3×)/−50 dB(1.12×),远低于整链 ~−42 dB 的实际水平;窄带模式不要为 EVM 放宽 corner——放宽换来的余量没人消费,却牺牲邻道的模拟抑制(洞察⑤;测这个地板还揪出过两层时延补偿伪影,见洞察⑥)。库里 recommended_lpf_corner_hz() 封装了这条策略。

The corner ratios are uniform across bandwidths: TX 1.3×BW/2 preserves the DPD spectrum (insight ②), RX 1.12× performs channel selection. The measured 20 MHz single-LPF ISI floors are −55 (1.3×) / −50 dB (1.12×), far below the chain's actual ~−42 dB level; narrow modes should NOT relax the corner for EVM — the margin bought goes unconsumed while analog adjacent-channel rejection is sacrificed (insight ⑤; measuring that floor also flushed out two layers of delay-compensation artifact, see insight ⑥). recommended_lpf_corner_hz() encodes the policy.

3.4 PA 非线性3.4 PA nonlinearity

默认无记忆 Saleh 模型,AM/AM 与 AM/PM:

The default is the memoryless Saleh model, AM/AM and AM/PM:

经 ScaledPA 包装成指定增益(26 dB)与 Psat(28 dBm)。可切换 Wiener-Hammerstein 记忆 PA(ReferencePA)或从谐波平衡仿真 CSV 导入实测 AM/AM。DPD 学习的广义记忆多项式(GMP)基函数:

wrapped by ScaledPA to the specified gain (26 dB) and Psat (28 dBm). A Wiener-Hammerstein memory PA (ReferencePA) or a measured AM/AM imported from harmonic-balance CSV can be swapped in. The generalized memory polynomial (GMP) the DPD learns uses basis terms:

3.5 接收机损伤3.5 Receiver impairments

LNA/AGC:四档前端增益态,每档有各自的增益/NF/IIP3/切换门限;热噪声按当前档的 NF 在输入端注入。三阶非线性按档位 IIP3 建模 ;二阶失真(IM2)是直接变频的特有问题:混频器失配让包络平方项 漏到基带,IIP2 依赖片上 trim 码,最优码随工艺随机。DC 偏置:LO 自混频,逐档不同。ADC/DAC:量化 + 满量程边界 + 可选孔径抖动。时钟:CFO 与采样钟偏差(SCO)同源(同一晶振 ppm)。

LNA/AGC: four front-end gain states, each with its own gain/NF/IIP3/handover threshold; thermal noise enters at the input per the active state's NF. Third-order nonlinearity per-state, ; second-order distortion (IM2) is direct conversion's signature problem: mixer mismatch leaks the squared envelope to baseband, and the effective IIP2 depends on an on-chip trim code whose optimum is a random process variable. DC offsets: LO self-mixing, different per gain state. ADC/DAC: quantization, the full-scale boundary, optional aperture jitter. Clock: CFO and sampling-clock offset (SCO) share one crystal ppm.

每个损伤块都有 enabled 开关和 injected() 真值接口——校准算法的每个估计量都能和注入值对拍,这是整个测试体系的地基(inject → estimate → correct → verify)。

Every impairment block has an enabled switch and an injected() ground-truth interface — every quantity a calibration estimates can be checked against what was injected, the foundation of the whole test methodology (inject → estimate → correct → verify).

4 校准算法逐项讲解4 The calibrations, one by one

4.0 阅读方式4.0 How to read this chapter

每节固定四段:原理(推导+测量设置示意)→ 实现(源码函数指引)→ 证据(构建时真实运行的前后对比)→ 关键数字。所有前后数字来自同一次 80 MHz factory 档全序列运行(工艺种子固定),与第 5 章的顺序图、第 6 章的结果同源。

Every section has the same four parts: principle (derivation + measurement-setup schematic) → implementation (pointers into the source) → evidence (before/after from a real run at build time) → the key numbers. All numbers come from one 80 MHz factory-profile full-sequence run (fixed process seed), the same run behind chapter 5's ordering and chapter 6's results.

4.1 LPF corner(RC 调谐)4.1 LPF corner (RC tuning)

原理:在标称截止频率 与低频参考 处各发一个单音,二者的功率比给出通带边沿的实际衰减;扫描 RC 调谐码,选功率比最接近 −3 dB 的码字。TX 侧经包络检波器读出(不依赖 RX),RX 侧经 ADC 读出。

Principle: transmit one tone at the nominal corner and one at a low-frequency reference ; their power ratio reads the actual edge attenuation. Sweep the RC code and pick the one landing closest to −3 dB. The TX side reads through the envelope detector (no RX involved), the RX side through the ADC.

实现:cal/lpf_corner.py,factory 档全码扫描、poweron 档二分搜索;检波器响应用 det.response() 补偿。为什么最先做:后续所有频域估计都经过这两个滤波器,corner 不校准,后面全被通带畸变污染。

Implementation: cal/lpf_corner.py — full code sweep in the factory profile, bisection in poweron; the detector's own response is compensated via det.response(). Why first: every later frequency-domain estimate passes through these filters; an uncalibrated corner pollutes everything downstream.

证据:本次运行 corner 误差从 12.2% 校到 0.18%(选中码 22),压进 1 LSB 步进内。

Evidence: this run pulled the corner error from 12.2% to 0.18% (code 22), inside one LSB step.

4.2 RX DC 偏置4.2 RX DC offset

原理:端口端接(零输入)下逐 AGC 档平均 ADC 输出,得到每档的复 DC,建立逐档数字消除表。逐档是物理要求:主要来源是 LO 自混频,其电平随前端增益档变化。

Principle: with the port terminated (zero input), average the ADC output per AGC state to get each state's complex DC and build a per-state digital subtraction table. Per-state is physics, not caution: the dominant source is LO self-mixing, which changes with front-end gain.

实现:cal/rx_dc.py。证据:最高增益档 DC 从 -25.1 dBFS 压到全档最差 -83.8 dBFS。为什么在 LO 泄漏校准之前:环回法里 TX 泄漏与 RX 残余 DC 都在近零频,先清掉 RX 自己的 DC,泄漏测量才干净(第 5 章依赖图里这是一条被强制执行的边)。

Implementation: cal/rx_dc.py. Evidence: highest-gain-state DC pulled from -25.1 dBFS to a worst-state -83.8 dBFS. Why before the LO-leak cal: in the loopback method both the TX leak and the RX's own residual DC live near zero frequency; purging the RX DC first keeps the leak measurement clean (an enforced edge in chapter 5's dependency graph).

4.3 TX LO 泄漏4.3 TX LO leakage

方法一(包络检波,粗校):发单音 ,泄漏 与主音在平方律检波器输出中拍频于 :

Method 1 (envelope detector, coarse): transmit a tone ; the leak beats with it in the square-law detector at :

拍频功率是数字预失调 dc_pre 的二次型,对 I、Q 两轴各做三点抛物线拟合直接跳到顶点,迭代两三轮收敛——不依赖 RX。

The beat power is a quadratic in the digital pre-offset dc_pre; a three-point parabola fit per axis jumps straight to the vertex, converging in two-three iterations — no RX involved.

方法二(环回,精校):RX LO 加偏移 ,TX 载波泄漏在捕获频谱里落到 bin,与 RX 残余 DC(0 bin)分离;注入已知数字 DC 导频测出 dc_pre → 泄漏 bin 的复传输增益 ,一步解出:

Method 2 (loopback, fine): offset the RX LO by so the TX carrier leak lands on the bin, separated from the RX's residual DC (bin 0). Inject a known digital DC pilot to measure the complex transfer gain from dc_pre to the leak bin, then solve in one step:

证据:-64.8 dBc → -70.6 dBc。实现:cal/tx_lo_leak.py。

Evidence: -64.8 dBc → -70.6 dBc. Implementation: cal/tx_lo_leak.py.

4.4 RX IIP2 trim4.4 RX IIP2 trim

原理:发双音 ,混频器二阶失真把包络平方项下变频到基带,在 产生 IM2 拍;IM2 幅度与 trim 码近似线性,故 IM2 功率是 trim 码的抛物线,三点拟合+ 信赖域迭代找零点。

Principle: transmit a two-tone ; second-order mixer distortion downconverts the squared envelope, producing an IM2 beat at . The IM2 amplitude is ~linear in the trim code, so IM2 power is a parabola in the code — three-point fit plus a trust-region iteration finds the null.

三个必须知道的陷阱(都是被真实调试逼出来的):① 必须排在 TX LO 泄漏校准之后——PA 三阶积 恰好落在 测量 bin 上,未校的载波泄漏能把 IM2 null 埋掉 ~35 dB;② 量化器杂散会污染弱 IM2 读数,用相位随机化相干平均(每次捕获给双音一个随机公共相位,IM2 bin 相干、杂散非相干)压掉;③ 相位随机化救不了 TX 侧的偶阶失真——DAC 对双音的二阶积同样落在 且与音对相位差相干,这个随信道透传的背景与 trim 码无关,会把 null 填平甚至推歪(320 MHz 下整个码域只剩 ~1 dB 起伏)。解法是双电平分离:每个码在两个相差 6 dB 的耦合衰减下各测一次,线性信道(音与 TX 背景一起)按音调 bin 复比值 归一化后相减 ,只留下本地混频器 IM2——真实硅片上激励源自身 IP2 不可信时用的同一招。

Three traps you must know (all earned in real debugging): ① it must run after the TX LO-leak cal — the PA's third-order product lands exactly on the measurement bin, and an uncalibrated carrier leak buries the IM2 null by ~35 dB; ② quantizer spurs pollute weak IM2 readings — suppressed by phase-randomized coherent averaging (each capture gives the tone pair a random common phase: the IM2 bin adds coherently, the spurs don't); ③ phase randomization cannot save you from TX-side even-order distortion — the DAC's second-order product of the tone pair lands on the same bin, coherent with the tone phase difference. That transmitted, code-independent background flattens or tilts the null (at 320 MHz the whole code range showed ~1 dB of ripple). The cure is two-level separation: measure each code at two coupler attenuations 6 dB apart and subtract after normalizing by the complex tone-bin ratio ( ) — the linear channel (tones and TX background alike) cancels, leaving only the local mixer IM2. The same trick real silicon uses when the cal source's own IP2 cannot be trusted.

证据:有效 IIP2 45.2 → 75.0 dBm,搜索停在码 39(注入真值最优码 39)。实现:cal/rx_iip2.py。

Evidence: effective IIP2 45.2 → 75.0 dBm, search settled on code 39 (injected-truth optimum 39). Implementation: cal/rx_iip2.py.

4.5 环回时延测量4.5 Loopback delay

原理:整数时延由互相关峰给出,分数部分由峰值三点抛物线插值估计、FFT 相位斜坡去除。它本身不编程任何校正,但后续所有 FFT-bin 校准的捕获对齐都靠它——IIR 滤波器还贡献启动瞬态,捕获统一带 512 样本循环预热前缀。本次运行时延 29.66 ns。实现:cal/sync.py。

Principle: the integer delay is the cross-correlation peak; the fractional part comes from three-point parabolic interpolation of the peak and is removed with an FFT phase ramp. It programs nothing itself, but every later FFT-bin calibration aligns its captures with this estimate — and because the IIR filters also contribute startup transients, captures carry a 512-sample cyclic warm-up prefix. This run: 29.66 ns. Implementation: cal/sync.py.

4.6 TX 频变 IQ(核心)4.6 TX frequency-dependent IQ (the core)

这是整套校准里最精巧的一步。难点:环回观测里 TX 镜像、RX 镜像、环回信道响应搅在一起,如何只测 TX?解法:RX-LO 偏移 让三者落到三个不同的 bin:频率 的 TX 音出现在 ,TX 镜像在 ,RX 自己的镜像在 。

The most delicate step in the suite. The problem: in loopback the TX image, RX image and loopback channel response are entangled — how do you measure only TX? The trick: an RX-LO offset separates all three onto different bins: a TX tone at lands at , its TX image at , and the RX's own image at .

发正频梳状音,再发负频梳状音。第一次捕获在镜像 bin 读到 ;第二次捕获在同一物理 bin(此时是直达音)读到 ——两式共享同一个环回/RX 线性响应 ,取比值精确抵消:

Transmit a positive-frequency comb, then a negative one. The first capture reads the image bin ; the second reads the same physical bin (now carrying a direct tone), — both share the same loopback/RX response , so the ratio cancels it exactly:

逐频点得到 后,预失真采用 widely-linear 校正 ,共轭路 FIR 由频率采样最小二乘设计:

With measured per frequency, the pre-corrector is widely-linear, , its conjugate-path FIR designed by frequency-sampling least squares:

设计细节有一个真实教训:只约束测量频点会让 FIR 在未约束的 Nyquist 区间自由振荡(系数范数爆到 12.9,放大共轭路噪声),必须在全 网格上约束、带外锥化到零 + 岭正则。梳状音幅度也有讲究:压到 0.03–0.04,否则 PA 的单边 IM3 组合 恰好落进镜像 bin,把弱镜像淹掉。

One earned lesson in the FIR design: constraining only the measured tones lets the FIR ring freely in the unconstrained Nyquist region (tap norm blew up to 12.9, amplifying conjugate-path noise) — constrain the full grid with out-of-band taper-to-zero plus ridge regularization. Comb amplitude matters too: kept at 0.03–0.04, or the PA's one-sided IM3 combinations land in the image bins and bury the weak image.

证据:最差 IRR 32.2 dB → 56.4 dB。实现:cal/tx_iq.py(测量)、cal/wl_fir.py(FIR 设计)。

Evidence: worst IRR 32.2 dB → 56.4 dB. Implementation: cal/tx_iq.py (measurement), cal/wl_fir.py (FIR design).

4.7 群时延失配验证4.7 Group-delay mismatch check

I/Q 轨间纯群时延失配 是频变失衡的特例:小失配下 、 ,因此 对 的斜率就是 。从 4.6 已测的 免费提取,并与注入真值对照:估计 -158 ps,注入 -129 ps,误差 -30 ps。实现:cal/group_delay.py。

A pure inter-rail group-delay mismatch is a special case of the frequency-dependent imbalance: for small mismatch and , so the slope of against is — extracted for free from 4.6's measured and checked against the injected truth: estimated -158 ps vs injected -129 ps, error -30 ps. Implementation: cal/group_delay.py.

4.8 RX 频变 IQ4.8 RX frequency-dependent IQ

TX 校好之后,RX 侧不再需要偏移:共 LO 发单边梳状音 ,捕获里 、 ,两 bin 相除让信源项完全抵消:

With TX already clean, the RX side needs no offset: transmit single-sideband combs with shared LO; the capture gives and , and dividing the two bins makes the source term cancel entirely:

后置 widely-linear FIR 校正。顺序为什么不能反:若 TX 镜像还在,这一步会把它归罪给 RX,得到一个'TX 抵消 RX'的解——环回里镜像消了,天线口的镜像反而更差。这条约束在 cal/deps.py 里是数据,由测试强制执行。证据:最差 IRR 32.1 → 57.9 dB。实现:cal/rx_iq.py。

A post widely-linear FIR corrects it. Why the order cannot flip: with the TX image still present this step attributes it to the RX and converges on a TX-cancels-RX solution — the loopback image nulls while the antenna-side image gets worse. That constraint is data in cal/deps.py, enforced by tests. Evidence: worst IRR 32.1 → 57.9 dB. Implementation: cal/rx_iq.py.

4.9 TX 功率4.9 TX power

OFDM 激励下扫增益码,经观测路径实测 PA 输出功率,建立码字→dBm 查找表并可插值命中目标功率;表内单调性是通过判据。np.interp 会静默钳位,目标落在表外时结果码触轨——这正是 saturated 标志(见第 6 章)存在的原因之一。实现:cal/tx_power.py。

Sweep the gain code under OFDM drive, measure true PA output power through the observation path, and build the code→dBm lookup (interpolating to hit a target). Monotonicity is the pass criterion. np.interp clips silently — a target outside the table rails the resulting code, one of the reasons the saturated flag (chapter 6) exists. Implementation: cal/tx_power.py.

4.10 DPD(间接学习)4.10 DPD (indirect learning)

原理:间接学习架构(ILA)。环回捕获对齐后,以第 0 轮的线性增益为固定目标增益:

Principle: the indirect-learning architecture (ILA). After aligned loopback capture, fix the target gain from iteration 0:

对 (捕获/ → 实际驱动 ) 拟合 GMP 后逆,再把系数复制为预失真器;迭代至 ACLR 收敛。 冻结是稳定性关键:目标增益随轮漂移会让迭代追自己的尾巴。

fit a GMP post-inverse from (capture/ → the actual drive ), copy the coefficients into the predistorter, iterate until ACLR converges. Freezing is the stability key: a per-iteration drifting target makes the loop chase its own tail.

为什么必须最后做:ILA 对观测到的一切失真照单全收,残余 IQ 镜像/泄漏会被学进 GMP 系数并在所有驱动电平上重放。带宽有两个硬前提:过采样率 4(os=2 时预失真频谱被混叠+TX LPF 剥掉,EVM 卡死在 −35 dB 与电平无关);观测路径用宽带模式(RX LPF 旁路)。

Why it must run last: ILA learns whatever distortion it observes — residual IQ image/leak gets baked into the GMP coefficients and replayed at every drive level. Two hard bandwidth prerequisites: oversampling 4 (at os=2 aliasing plus the TX LPF strip the correction spectrum and EVM pins at −35 dB regardless of level), and a wideband observation path (RX LPF bypassed).

证据:EVM -35.2 → -41.9 dB,最差 ACLR -40.1 → -44.1 dBc。实现:cal/dpd_cal.py、dpd/ila.py、pa/gmp.py。

Evidence: EVM -35.2 → -41.9 dB, worst ACLR -40.1 → -44.1 dBc. Implementation: cal/dpd_cal.py, dpd/ila.py, pa/gmp.py.

4.11 AGC 验证4.11 AGC verification

全部校正生效后扫输入功率:验证 LNA 档位切换、ADC 落点(目标 FS − 12 dB)与 SNR 单调性。本次最差落点误差 0.11 dB。实现:cal/agc_cal.py。

With every correction active, sweep the input power: verify LNA handovers, the ADC landing point (target FS − 12 dB) and SNR sanity. Worst landing error this run: 0.11 dB. Implementation: cal/agc_cal.py.

4.12 最终环回 EVM4.12 Final loopback EVM

全链路验收:同一 OFDM 帧,逐音均衡 + 公共相位去除(规范 EVM 测法)。复合环回 EVM -29.3 → -44.5 dB;PA 输出处的 TX EVM(802.11be 规范测量点)为 -42.3 dB。星座图与频谱前后对比:

The end-to-end acceptance: the same OFDM frame, per-tone equalization plus common-phase removal (the standard EVM method). Composite loopback EVM -29.3 → -44.5 dB; TX EVM at the PA output (the 802.11be measurement point) -42.3 dB. Constellation and spectrum, before vs after:

5 校准顺序与耗时预算5 Ordering and the capture-time budget

5.1 顺序不是习惯,是物理5.1 The order is physics, not habit

排错顺序的校准不会失败——它会收敛到错误答案:RX IQ 在 TX IQ 之前跑会把 TX 镜像吸收进 RX 校正器;IIP2 在 LO 泄漏之前跑,测量 bin 被 PA 三阶积占据。因此顺序约束在 cal/deps.py 里是数据(每条边带物理理由),序列在第一次捕获之前校验计划,测试锁死违例。下图由构建脚本直接从该表生成——悬停边可见理由,图和代码不可能脱节:

A mis-ordered calibration does not fail — it converges on the wrong answer: RX IQ before TX IQ absorbs the TX image into the RX corrector; IIP2 before the LO-leak cal measures a bin occupied by a PA third-order product. So the ordering constraints are data in cal/deps.py (every edge carries its physical reason), the sequence validates the plan before the first capture, and tests pin the rules. The graph below is generated straight from that table at build time — hover an edge for its reason; the figure cannot drift from the code:

5.2 捕获耗时预算:factory 与 poweron5.2 The capture budget: factory vs power-on

校准时间就是产测成本。每一步都上报捕获次数与样本数(时间 = 样本数 / ,不含 DSP):

Calibration time is production-test cost. Every step reports its capture count and sample count (time = samples / , DSP excluded):

两档策略:factory(全码扫描、长捕获、双轮 IQ)本次共 253 次捕获、12.6 ms;poweron(二分码搜索、半长捕获、单轮 IQ、跳过 envdet 粗校)压缩到 82 次、2.6 ms,EVM 代价 -44.5 → -44.4 dB。上电预算还应计入 PLL 锁定时间(报告生成器的预算表内建此行,二阶环路包络估计)。

Two profiles: factory (full code sweeps, long captures, two IQ iterations) took 253 captures / 12.6 ms this run; poweron (bisection code search, half-length captures, single IQ iteration, envdet stage skipped) compresses that to 82 captures / 2.6 ms at an EVM cost of -44.5 → -44.4 dB. A power-on budget should also include PLL lock time (the report generator's budget table has a built-in row for it, a second-order loop-envelope estimate).

6 跟踪、温度与端到端结果6 Tracking, temperature and end-to-end results

6.1 PA 热漂移跟踪(RLS DPD)6.1 PA thermal-drift tracking (RLS DPD)

工厂校准的 DPD 在 PA 温漂下会过期。RLS 跟踪环在线更新 GMP 系数;关键参数是遗忘因子——这里的教训:每块更新而非每样本,forget=0.995 级别的'常规'取值在块级更新下等于几乎不遗忘,漂移后残留 20 dB 滞后;块级 forget=0.4 才跟得上。本次运行:跟踪 DPD 收敛到 -62.6 dB,距逐状态重训的 oracle 仅 -0.2 dB,而冻结 DPD 最差劣化到 -37.3 dB。

A factory-calibrated DPD goes stale as the PA drifts thermally. An RLS tracking loop updates the GMP coefficients online; the critical knob is the forgetting factor — the lesson here: updates are per block, not per sample, so a 'textbook' forget=0.995 barely forgets at block level and lags drift by 20 dB; block-level forget=0.4 keeps up. This run: tracking DPD converges to -62.6 dB, only -0.2 dB from the per-state retrained oracle, while the frozen DPD degrades to -37.3 dB at worst.

6.2 温度保持性与失效窗口6.2 Temperature hold and the validity window

校正冻结在 25°C 值,扫温逐规格复测(判据用结果里内嵌的 spec,与交付检查器同一条规则)。泄漏 null 是按校准温度幅度配平的,温漂任一方向都会破坏它:

Corrections frozen at their 25 °C values, specs re-measured across temperature (judged against the specs embedded in the results — the same rule the handoff inspector applies). The leak null is amplitude-matched at the calibration temperature, so drift in either direction breaks it:

结论写进交付文件的 expiry 元数据:本次保持窗口 -10…55 °C;越界后的最小重校子序列 9 步、约 8.0 ms 捕获(由依赖闭包自动推导,含测量前置步骤)。

The conclusion ships as expiry metadata in the cal-state file: hold window -10…55 °C this run; the minimal recal subsequence after leaving it is 9 steps / ~8.0 ms of captures (derived automatically as the dependency closure, measurement prerequisites included).

6.3 灵敏度:模型对拍解析预算6.3 Sensitivity: model vs analytic budget

同一个数,两条独立路径:Friis 解析底限 ,与行为模型实测(EVM 过 交点)。二者一致校验的是整条噪声/单位/EVM 管线——这类交叉验证曾当场抓到 rx-only 路径漏掉群时延对齐导致的 −28 dB EVM 地板。

One number, two independent routes: the analytic Friis floor , and the behavioral model's measurement (the input power where EVM crosses ). Their agreement validates the whole noise/units/EVM plumbing — this exact cross-check caught a −28 dB EVM floor from a missing group-delay alignment in the rx-only path.

6.4 工艺良率与旗舰结果6.4 Process yield and the flagship numbers

小规模 Monte-Carlo(6 个随机工艺角,poweron 快速档):校后环回 EVM 中位数 -35.5 dB、最差 -35.4 dB。完整良率门禁是 nightly 的 run_yield(20 角、全档),历史结果 100% 通过全部限值。

A small Monte-Carlo (6 random process corners, poweron profile): post-cal loopback EVM median -35.5 dB, worst -35.4 dB. The full yield gate is the nightly run_yield (20 corners, factory profile), historically 100% against every limit.

旗舰配置 320 MHz / 4096-QAM 的验收数字由测试套件断言(tests/test_e2e.py::test_full_sequence_320mhz 及相关):TX EVM ≤ −38 dB(802.11be MCS13),实测约 −39.8 dB,真实电路数据导入路径约 −41.4 dB。本教程的构建配置(80 MHz)为求速度,不替代上述验收值。

The flagship 320 MHz / 4096-QAM acceptance numbers are asserted by the test suite (tests/test_e2e.py::test_full_sequence_320mhz and friends): TX EVM ≤ −38 dB (802.11be MCS13), measured ≈ −39.8 dB, and ≈ −41.4 dB on the circuit-data import path. This tutorial's build config (80 MHz) trades fidelity for speed and does not replace those acceptance values.

7 设计洞察7 Design insights

7.1 模型换来的电路结论7.1 Circuit conclusions the model paid for

① 4096-QAM 必须配低相噪综合器。IPN ≈ −38 dBc 的 LO 单独就吃掉整个 −38 dB EVM 预算——CPE 去除救不了子载波间相噪;需要 −43 dBc 量级。模型默认剖面按 PLL 组的抖动指标锚定:120 fs rms(10 kHz–100 MHz 积分,6 GHz 载频,IPN −46.9 dBc,0.26° rms)。积分下限取 10 kHz 是 CPE 给的松绑——更近端的 frac-N 噪声被逐符号公共相位去除赦免。这是给 PLL 组的硬指标,不是仿真参数偏好。

① 4096-QAM demands a low-phase-noise synthesizer. An LO at IPN ≈ −38 dBc alone consumes the entire −38 dB EVM budget — CPE removal does not rescue inter-subcarrier phase noise; a −43 dBc class is required. The default profile is anchored to the PLL team's jitter target: 120 fs rms (integrated 10 kHz–100 MHz at the 6 GHz carrier; IPN −46.9 dBc, 0.26° rms). The 10 kHz lower integration bound is CPE's gift — closer-in fractional-N noise is absolved by per-symbol common-phase removal. A hard requirement for the PLL team, not a simulation preference.

② 320 MHz 模式的 TX 基带 LPF 必须比信道宽(≥1.3×BW/2)。DPD 预失真频谱比信号宽;corner 贴着信道边沿会把校正剥掉,PA 残余 EVM 卡在 −39 dB 附近,怎么加迭代都无用。滤波器规格要为 DPD 留带宽。

② The 320 MHz-mode TX baseband LPF must be wider than the channel (≥1.3×BW/2). The predistorted spectrum is wider than the signal; a corner hugging the channel edge strips the correction and pins residual PA EVM near −39 dB no matter how many iterations run. Spec the filter for DPD bandwidth.

③ IIP2 校准必须排在 LO 泄漏校准之后。PA 三阶积 正落在 IM2 测量 bin,未校泄漏埋掉 null ~35 dB。这是校准顺序由电路机理决定的最典型例子。

③ The IIP2 cal must follow the LO-leak cal. The PA product lands exactly on the IM2 measurement bin; an uncalibrated leak buries the null by ~35 dB. The clearest case of calibration order being dictated by circuit mechanism.

④ 跟踪环的遗忘因子按块不按样本。RLS 每块更新一次时,forget=0.995 意味着几乎永不遗忘,PA 漂移后残留 20 dB 滞后;块级 forget=0.4 才是同一物理时间常数的正确换算。

④ Tracking-loop forgetting factors are per block, not per sample. With one RLS update per block, forget=0.995 means almost never forgetting — 20 dB of lag after PA drift; block-level forget=0.4 is the same physical time constant correctly rescaled.

⑤ 窄带模式:校准激励随带宽缩放,corner 比例保持统一。23 MHz 探测音在 20 MHz 信道里是带外音——IIP2 trim 在噪声上乱走、AGC 扫描读不到 SNR,这是窄带校准失败的真正(也是唯一的)功能性原因,激励频率必须随带宽缩放。corner 比例则全带宽统一 1.3×(TX)/1.12×(RX):无伪影仪表实测 20 MHz 单 LPF 地板 −55/−50 dB,比整链实际到达的 ~−42 dB 低 12 dB 以上。曾短暂采用的窄带 3× 策略已撤销——它只买到没人消费的余量(TX EVM +1.5 dB、环回观测底板 +11 dB),代价是邻道模拟抑制从 ~25 dB 塌到 ~0 dB、blocker 全压到 ADC 动态范围。EVM 指标不给 blocker 定价,corner 规格必须给。此条由 20 MHz GUI 运行的异常直接换来。

⑤ Narrow modes: scale calibration probes with bandwidth; keep the corner ratios uniform. A 23 MHz probe tone is out-of-channel at 20 MHz — the IIP2 trim walks on noise and the AGC sweep reads no SNR at all; that is the real (and only) functional failure of narrow-mode calibration, so probe frequencies must scale with bandwidth. The corner ratios stay uniform at every bandwidth — 1.3× (TX) / 1.12× (RX): the artifact-free 20 MHz single-LPF floors are −55/−50 dB, 12+ dB below the ~−42 dB the calibrated chain actually reaches. A briefly-adopted 3× narrow-mode policy was reverted: it bought only unconsumed margin (+1.5 dB TX EVM, +11 dB loopback-observation floor) while collapsing analog adjacent-channel rejection from ~25 dB to ~0 dB, dumping the blocker onto ADC dynamic range. EVM does not price blockers; the corner spec must. Paid for directly by an anomalous 20 MHz GUI run.

⑥ 先校准测量仪器,再给电路定规格。最初诊断出的"1.3× corner 在 20 MHz 把 EVM 钉死在 −33 dB"是测量伪影:测试接收机模型的时延补偿用循环 FFT 移位整体前移捕获,把 warm-up 样本卷进最后一个符号的 FFT 窗。误差正比于滤波器群时延(所以跟着 corner 变!)、反比于 FFT 长度(所以 320 MHz 看不见、20 MHz 最重),完美伪装成物理 ISI 地板;换一个符号数,数字就漂移——这正是暴露它的线索。修复后还剩第二层:时延补偿把最后一个符号的 FFT 窗推出 burst 末尾几个采样,截断的 ramp-down 让延续内容失真,在深地板上仍值 >8 dB——现在多发一个 padding 符号、只对内部符号打分(实验室标准做法)。全部修完后真实地板在 1.3× 即有 −55 dB,基于伪影数据定下的窄带 3× corner 策略随之撤销(见⑤)。任何随测量配置漂移的"物理结论"都要先怀疑测量本身。

⑥ Calibrate the measuring instrument before spec'ing the circuit. The originally diagnosed "−33 dB EVM floor at a 1.3× corner" was a measurement artifact: the test-receiver model's delay compensation circularly advanced the whole capture, wrapping warm-up samples into the last symbol's FFT window. The error scales with filter group delay (so it tracked the corner!) and inversely with FFT size (so 320 MHz never saw it and 20 MHz was hit hardest) — a perfect impostor of a physical ISI floor. Its numbers drifted with the symbol count, which is the clue that exposed it. A second layer remained after the fix: delay compensation pushes the final symbol's FFT window a few samples past the burst end, where the truncated ramp-down misrepresents the continuation — still worth >8 dB on deep floors; the EVM meter now transmits one padding symbol and scores interior symbols only (lab practice). With both fixed, the true floor at 1.3× is already −55 dB, and the narrow-mode 3× corner policy that had been founded on the artifact data was reverted (see ⑤). Any "physical" conclusion that drifts with the measurement configuration indicts the measurement first.

8 使用指南与交付接口8 User guide and deliverable interfaces

8.1 安装与最小调用8.1 Install and the minimal contract

pip install -e .(GUI 需要 pip install -e '.[gui]';库、CLI 与独立检查器都不依赖 Qt)。最小调用:

pip install -e . (the GUI needs pip install -e '.[gui]'; the library, CLI and standalone inspector need no Qt). The minimal contract:

import numpy as np
from wifitrx.chain import (TxChain, TxParams, RxChain, RxParams,
                            LoopbackPath, run_loopback)

bw, fs = 320e6, 320e6 * 4
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
tx = TxChain(TxParams(bandwidth_hz=bw).randomize(rng), fs)
rx = RxChain(RxParams(bandwidth_hz=bw).randomize(rng), fs)

x = np.load('your_11be_waveform.npy')  # digital FS, rms ~0.1-0.15
y_pa = tx(x)                    # sqrt(mW) @ PA out
cap = run_loopback(tx, rx, x,
                   LoopbackPath(atten_db=40.0, delay_ns=6.0))

8.2 校准状态文件与独立检查器8.2 The cal-state file and the standalone inspector

save_cal_state() 产出的 JSON 是核心交付物:全部数字校正 + 模拟调谐码(仅凭文件即可恢复芯片编程)、逐步结果(passed / saturated / 内嵌 spec)、溯源与 expiry(温度有效窗 + 最小重校计划)。三种方式读它,结论同源:

The JSON from save_cal_state() is the core deliverable: every digital correction plus the analog tuning codes (the file alone restores the chip), per-step results (passed / saturated / embedded spec), provenance and expiry (temperature validity window + minimal recal plan). Three ways to read it, one set of verdicts:

python -m wifitrx.handoff inspect cal_state.json
# or copy src/wifitrx/handoff/inspector.py next to the JSON:
python inspector.py cal_state.json   # stdlib-only
# or the GUI tab: Cal-state inspector

检查器以文件内嵌的 spec 为判据——旧文件按其校准当时的规格判定,而不是按库的当前表;这保证半年后检查一个旧交付包时,报出的是文件的问题而不是库的演进。

The inspector judges against the spec embedded in the file — an old file is held to the spec it was calibrated to, not the library's current table, so inspecting a six-month-old bundle reports the file's problems, not the library's evolution.

8.3 波形交接与批量回归8.3 Waveform handoff and batch regression

波形走 wifitrx-wave-v1(.npz:iq + 元数据,带采样率/幅度/NaN 校验);单波形与目录级批量:

Waveforms travel as wifitrx-wave-v1 (.npz: iq + metadata, with rate/amplitude/NaN validation); single-shot and directory-level batch:

python -m wifitrx.handoff run --wave wave.npz --bw 320e6 --scenario loopback
python -m wifitrx.handoff regress --dir waves/ --bw 320e6   # -> handoff_report.md

scenario 三选:tx_only(PA 输出)/ loopback / rx_only。regress 产出双方各填一列的指标对账单。电路数据接入(PA 谐波平衡、LPF AC、PLL 相噪 CSV)见 docs/circuit_data_zh.md,模板在 circuit_data/。

Three scenarios: tx_only (PA output) / loopback / rx_only. regress produces the reconciliation sheet with one column per party. Circuit-data import (PA harmonic balance, LPF AC, PLL phase-noise CSVs) is documented in docs/circuit_data_zh.md with templates under circuit_data/.

8.4 GUI 工作台8.4 The GUI workbench

python app/main.py,两个页签:Analyses(全量校准、漂移跟踪、阻塞退敏、杂散规划,参数表单由声明式 spec 生成,结果 2×2 仪表盘)与 Cal-state inspector(打开 JSON,渲染检查器结论/逐步表/溯源——页面自身不做任何判断,measured by test)。

python app/main.py, two tabs: Analyses (full calibration, drift tracking, blocker desense, spur planning; forms generated from declarative specs, results in a 2×2 dashboard) and Cal-state inspector (open a JSON and read the inspector's findings / step table / provenance — the page itself decides nothing, and a test enforces that).

9 已知简化与边界9 Known simplifications and boundaries

9.1 模型明确不覆盖什么9.1 What the model deliberately does not cover

诚实的边界清单,引用前请核对:① DAC/ADC 镜像与 replica 不建模(单一仿真采样率;ZOH droop 可选);② 无信道编码与完整 802.11be 帧——PER 级链路验证属于通信组的 PHY,本模型提供简化 preamble/pilot 供对拍;③ PA 默认无记忆 Saleh,记忆效应用 ReferencePA/导入数据启用;④ RX 谐波混频、镜像抑制混频器结构未建模;⑤ MIMO 解耦按平坦耦合矩阵处理(频变互耦留待后续);⑥ PLL 内部校准(VCO band select、KVCO 等)不在范围——对系统层可见的是相噪剖面 + 杂散 + 锁定时间,这三者已覆盖;⑦ 灵敏度的 SNR 需求列是预算近似,未经译码仿真复核。

The honest boundary list — check before quoting: ① DAC/ADC images and replicas are not modeled (single simulation rate; optional ZOH droop); ② no channel coding or full 802.11be framing — PER-level link validation belongs to the comm team's PHY, and the model provides simplified preamble/pilots for cross-checks; ③ the PA defaults to memoryless Saleh; memory effects come via ReferencePA or imported data; ④ RX harmonic mixing and image-reject mixer topologies are not modeled; ⑤ MIMO decoupling assumes a flat coupling matrix (frequency-dependent coupling is future work); ⑥ PLL-internal calibrations (VCO band select, KVCO…) are out of scope — what the system sees is the phase-noise profile, spurs and lock time, all covered; ⑦ the sensitivity table's SNR-requirement column is a budgeting approximation, not verified by coded simulation.

简化是声明出来的,不是藏起来的:每一条都对应源码里的开关或文档标注,交付对象可以据此判断哪些结论能直接引用、哪些需要自己的仿真补验。

Simplifications are declared, not hidden: each maps to a switch or a documented annotation in the source, so a recipient can tell which conclusions to quote directly and which to re-verify with their own simulations.
